newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices firm.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel prices firmed in thin trade on Monday, tracking gains in NYMEX front-month futures, traders said.
The week opened with a relatively quiet session and was not expected to pick up steam until traders return from an industry golf outing in Arizona that runs through Tuesday, traders said.
Unleaded, diesel and jet differentials were unchanged in morning discussion, traders said.
Spot Midwest prices were higher on a more than 0.75 cent a gallon rise in NYMEX May heating oil and nearly 1.0 cent a gallon gain in front-month unleaded in morning trade.
Traders expected unleaded gasoline basis to hold its ground this week after moving stronger last week, leaving prices to track the underlying NYMEX unleaded futures contract.
"It's very strong right now, and it should stay fairly stable," one trader active in the Group Three and Chicago spot markets said of the unleaded basis. "The market is trying to hold here."
Spot diesel prices in the Midwest markets were expected to move lower this week after surging higher in recent days on perceptions of tighter supplies in the Gulf Coast market, traders said.
"The basis should be walloped," one Group Three trader said last week.
